title: Keep remote intelligence off the live frame path
description: Choose a display target, place semantic inference, and adjust local work. The model shows whether one frame can reach the display before its deadline and how old an asynchronous remote result may be.

frameTargets.label: 60 fps · 16.7 ms
frameTargets.detail: A larger deadline for handheld AR or less motion-sensitive experiences.

frameTargets.label: 90 fps · 11.1 ms
frameTargets.detail: A tighter illustrative target for head-tracked immersive rendering.

frameTargets.label: 120 fps · 8.3 ms
frameTargets.detail: A demanding target that leaves little room for variable scene work.

inferenceModes.label: On-device · current frame
inferenceModes.detail: A bounded local model contributes directly to this frame.

inferenceModes.label: Nearby edge · future frame
inferenceModes.detail: The local path renders now; a versioned result may update a later frame.

inferenceModes.label: Cloud · future frame
inferenceModes.detail: Useful for durable state or heavy semantics, but the result is older on arrival.

inferenceModes.label: Cloud · block this frame
inferenceModes.detail: The renderer waits for a remote response before presenting the current frame.
